hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$file" && go vet ./...; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *internal/enforce* || "$file" == *scripts/install* ]]; then echo 'SECURITY-CRITICAL PATH: internal/enforce and scripts/install require explicit user confirmation before editing. Pause and confirm with the user.'; exit 2; fi
